Bundled dependencies for local report parsing:

- PDF.js 6.5.438 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- fflate 0.8.3 (MIT), https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate

Dependencies are bundled for offline desktop use; reports are not uploaded to a server. PDF extraction reads text only and does not execute embedded scripts. DOCX extraction reads word/document.xml only.
